ETH and SOL are fragile because of negative alpha, elevated beta, and high volatility. BCH, DOGE, and LTC have particularly weak supporting signals and liquidity characteristics. ETC is critically fragile: the zero price, zero volatility, and zero liquidity fields make its long verdict non-actionable and unsuitable for added
